name: Aoba Mieko
source:
She raises her son Yu on her own.

She is defenseless at home and can be a bit sloppy. She has not been in love or had sex since her divorce from her husband. Therefore, she is a little frustrated...

[From [url=http://www.hs-crowd.co.jp/anim/product/pro_pc/pc085/]official site[/url]]
